messages:
Samir: Heads-up — onboarding for tenant 'ordo' goes live Tue 09:00 UK. Need standby GPUs in eu-west-2 for first 8h. Anyone on quota/allocs?
Lina: How many and which types? Also any preference for reserved vs preemptible?
Samir: 6 x H100 (preemptible) to handle spikes, plus 2 x A100 (reserved) for baseline. Prefer reserved for the A100s.
Noah: Current reserved pool shows 1 free A100. Demo pool has 3 A100 but it's tagged demo:org-demo. We can re-tag 2 if procurement OK. proc:ping @devprocure-bot
devprocure-bot: Ticket created: PO-4692 — request 1x A100 reservation + 6x H100 standby (eu-west-2). ETA: pending vendor confirmation. :white_check_mark:
Jorge: If we need fast path, I can borrow 2 A100 from staging for the window. I'll open a PR to swap allocations — small terraform change:
```hcl
resource "redwood_gpu_allocation" "ordo-a100" {
  region = "eu-west-2"
  sku    = "a100-40gb"
  count  = 2
  tag    = "ordo-onboard"
}
```
Samir: Can someone review Jorge's PR? tagging @Maya for fast review — we need it merged before Monday EOD.
Maya: I can review in ~30m. Note: add billing_tag = "ordo-q1" to the resource so finance picks it up.
Lina: Also pinging vendor ops — @VendorOps can you confirm H100 standby capacity and any throttling window? We need 6 H100 from 03:30–11:30 UTC Tue.
VendorOps: Hi team — we can put 6 H100 on standby in eu-west-2 starting 04:00 UTC Tue, with 30m ramp. No throttling expected for that window. Will confirm final allocation by EOD tomorrow.
Noah: Let's plan a quick smoke canary 15m before go. Example script:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"h100-small","prompt":"smoke test"}'
```
Samir: Perfect — once VendorOps confirms, we'll merge Jorge's PR and I will trigger the canary. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
